review_candidates.title: Research Software Engineer – Native RNA Analysis
review_candidates.description: Would you like to take technical responsibility for a substantial scientific software platform and help operate it at scale? We are recruiting a Research Software Engineer for a short, intensive EPSRC-supported project bringing together mathematics, statistics, software engineering and molecular biology. Our team has developed a substantial end-to-end system for nanopore direct-RNA sequencing analysis, including raw signal processing, statistical calibration and read-level outputs. You will consolidate its operational connection to experimental data supply, run and develop the Snakemake-based workflows, and help manage data and compute at a scale potentially approaching 100 TB. You will maintain reproducible processing and reporting, and work with mathematicians, biostatisticians and biomedical collaborators at Oxford and UCL to develop analyses that address real scientific questions. Practical data stewardship is part of the role, working within the project's agreed institutional arrangements. We are looking for someone with strong Python and Linux skills, experience of reproducible workflows (ideally Snakemake), sound quantitative judgement and a collaborative approach. Experience with nanopore sequencing or specialist biostatistics is helpful but not essential. Applicants may hold either a PhD/DPhil, or equivalent research software development experience. The role provides a distinctive opportunity to deepen software engineering skills in an active biomedical research programme. This is a fixed-term Grade 7RS post ending no later than 30 April 2027, with an anticipated start as soon as possible. Full-time working is preferred, but part-time arrangements and secondments will be considered where they can meet the project’s operational requirements. We proudly hold a departmental Athena SWAN Gold Award and an institutional Race Equality Charter Bronze Award. Please direct informal enquiries to the HR Administrator (email: recruitment@maths.ox.ac.uk), quoting vacancy reference 190015. PLEASE NOTE: Applicants are responsible for contacting two of their referees and making sure that their letters are uploaded to https://workflow.maths.ox.ac.uk/form/reference?vacancy_id=190015 by the interview date. Job Description Applications for this vacancy are to be made online. To apply for this vacancy and for further information, including a job description and selection criteria, please click on the link below: https://my.corehr.com/pls/uoxrecruit/erq_jobspec_details_form.jobspec?p_id=190015 Only applications received before 12.00 noon UK time on Tuesday 1st December can be considered. Interviews are anticipated to take place on 4th December 2026.

You will develop foundational systems for data ingestion, structured context, permissions, and lineage, with significant autonomy to take work from an ambiguous problem to production. What You'll Do Design and ship production systems for data ingestion, structured context, and the governed data foundation used by applications. Build infrastructure to provision and manage customer AWS environments, translating diverse data formats into typed, related records with lineage and permissions. Own projects end-to-end, from initial requirements through reliable systems that support daily business workflows. Use LLMs and AI-assisted development tools as part of your engineering workflow. Contribute to technical direction and architecture decisions while collaborating with a lean engineering team. What We're Looking For 1 to 8 years of software engineering experience, with evidence of increasing responsibility or scope. Experience at an early-stage, venture-backed startup and at a well-regarded technology company. Hands-on experience designing and shipping data ingestion and transformation pipelines, including data schemas, lineage, and permissions. Strong computer science fundamentals, supported by a CS degree or a combined computer science and mathematics background. Practical experience with infrastructure as code and cloud infrastructure management, especially Terraform and AWS. Familiarity with technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Temporal, dbt, React, and Docker is relevant. Interest in fintech, data platforms, or alternative investments is valuable. Compensation & Benefits Salary range: $165,000 to $290,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. Location On-site in New York, United States.

review_candidates.title: Staff Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Sarai owner di un intero prodotto di Jet HR. Vorresti aprire la tua startup domani? Qui trovi già l’autonomia, i clienti, i soldi e la scala per costruire qualcosa che conta davvero. Cosa farai Hai un intero prodotto da costruire, con tutta l'ambiguità che comporta: decidi tu la direzione, cosa fare e cosa no, senza nessuno che te la confermi in anticipo. Guidi un prodotto intero. Dalla discovery al giorno in cui è nelle mani di migliaia di clienti: lo scopri, lo disegni, lo costruisci, lo porti in produzione. Decidi l'architettura. Stack, pattern, cosa rifattorizzare e cosa lasciare stare. Le scelte le fai tu, insieme al team con sui lavori. Non ti arriva nulla calato dall'alto. Semplifichi all’estremo. Il contributo più prezioso, spesso, è togliere: una feature che nessuno usa, una dipendenza in più, un livello di complessità che non serve a nessuno. Parli direttamente con gli utenti. Clienti, customer success, payroll. Capisci il problema alla fonte, senza un PM in mezzo che te lo traduce. Alzi il livello di chi lavora con te. Code review, pairing e decisioni prese insieme. Il tuo impatto si misura anche su quanto rendi più forti gli altri engineer, non solo su quello che produci. ‍ Come lavoriamo No PM, no designer. Se un progetto non ha davvero bisogno né dell'uno né dell'altro, lo porti avanti da solo con altri SWE, dalla scoperta del problema al rilascio. Full stack, full cycle. Costruisci, rilasci, monitori e sistemi quello che hai costruito. Non ci sono team dedicati di Dev Ops o QA a cui passare la palla. Pragmatismo. Niente architetture eleganti fini a se stesse: se un monolite risolve il problema più in fretta di sei microservizi, si usa il monolite. La complessità paga solo quando serve davvero a qualcosa. Veloce prima che perfetto. Un prodotto semplice e già in produzione batte un prodotto perfetto tra sei mesi. Si itera dopo, con dati e utenti veri. Tech stack Python/Django Vue.js AWS, Docker Libertà di introdurre qualcosa di nuovo, quando lo stack attuale davvero non basta più Chi cerchiamo In questo ruolo la seniority conta, ma non vogliamo vedere solo il numero di anni di esperienza sul CV. Hai visto roba mega complessa. Sistemi con molto debito tecnico, scala enorme, o complessi da costruire. Per arrivarci di solito servono almeno 4-5 anni di esperienza in scale-up o aziende con prodotti tech, non ferme da anni. Founder attitude . Hai fondato - o costruito da zero - qualcosa. Una startup, un side project con molti utenti veri, un prodotto interno che ha preso vita propria. Anche se non è andata come speravi. Ti muovi su tutto lo stack. Backend, frontend, infrastruttura: non devi essere il numero uno ovunque, ma non ti blocchi mai dicendo "non è il mio forte". Sapresti guidare un gruppo di persone . Non è un ruolo da people manager di default, ma vogliamo che tu abbia la stoffa per diventarlo: sai dare una direzione, prendere decisioni anche per altri, e risponderne. Hai già preso decisioni senza un PM. E ti sei preso la responsabilità di come sono andate le cose. Usi l'AI e automazioni varie. Se uno strumento per scrivere codice, testare o automatizzare un processo ti fa risparmiare ore, lo usi senza troppi problemi e spingi il resto del team a fare lo stesso. Ownership . Se qualcosa si rompe non aspetti che se ne accorga qualcun altro. Non importa il giorno o l’orario, sei pronto a risolvere il problema. Cosa offriamo €65.000 - €130.000+ di RAL. Valutiamo caso per caso. Full remote. Per davvero. Puoi lavorare da dove vuoi, basta che sia in una timezone compatibile con l'Italia. Se vuoi, il nostro ufficio a Milano è pronto ad accoglierti. Due volte l'anno abbiamo un offsite di 3 giorni, tutto pagato da Jet. Impatto concreto . Siamo una scale-up, ognuno dà un contributo essenziale allo sviluppo dei prodotti e alla crescita di Jet. Il tuo lavoro fa la differenza per migliaia di clienti. Hypergrowth. Imparerai come far funzionare un'azienda da una delle startup che cresce di più in Italia. Il team è zeppo di talenti: in 6 mesi costruirai cose che altrove richiederebbero anni. Processo di selezione Dopo un primo screening abbiamo: First interview - con il team Talent. Technical deep dive - tech interview, con un Senior Engineer del team. Tech interview - con CTO. Business interview - con co-founder. ⚠ Lavoriamo continuamente al miglioramento del nostro processo e cerchiamo di adattarlo a seconda del candidato. Il tuo processo potrebbe leggermente variare da quanto descritto.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer (5G)
review_candidates.description: Senior Software Engineer (5G) Company Overview We are located in San Diego, CA and we are a publicly traded communications company that has proudly been in business for over 20 years! We are on a mission to provide the highest quality service possible and bridging the digital divide across the globe. We work across a variety of different industries and we are one of the global leaders in our space that is constantly innovating and working with the latest technologies. Position Overview We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer (5G) to design, develop and optimize software for 5G modems and related subsystems. The role focuses on C++ implementation of protocol stack components and modem features, building robust abstractions (HAL/APIs), and ensuring performance and standards compliance (3GPP/GSMA). You will collaborate with RF, firmware, and systems teams to deliver 5G device and network solutions, drive technical decisions, and mentor junior engineers. Key Responsibilities Design, implement and maintain C++ software for 5G modem components and protocol stack elements (NAS, SDAP, RRC, PDCP, RLC, MAC, PHY). Develop and maintain software abstraction layers (HAL) and clear, stable APIs for modem and device integration. Optimize performance and resource usage for real-time and embedded targets, including profiling, memory and CPU optimization. Integrate and test modem software with SDKs, hardware platforms and target devices; perform bring-up and debugging on lab hardware. Work closely with cross-functional teams (RF, firmware, system integration, QA) to define interfaces and ensure end-to-end functionality. Drive compliance with 3GPP and GSMA standards, interpret specifications and translate requirements into engineering tasks. Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and set best practices for maintainable, testable code. Troubleshoot complex issues across software and hardware boundaries using logs, tracing, and diagnostics tools. Mentor and guide junior engineers, contribute to technical planning, and influence product and architecture decisions. Support feature delivery for both device (5G modem, 5G devices) and network-side components (RAN, gNodeB / base station) as required. Qualifications Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related field. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrable experience in C++ development. Direct experience with 5G modem software and protocol stacks (required). Strong understanding of cellular technologies (5G and LTE) and 3GPP specifications; familiarity with GSMA guidelines. Proven experience with modem-related layers: NAS, SDAP, RRC, PDCP, RLC, MAC and PHY. Experience with embedded systems, real-time constraints, and device bring-up (nice to have). Experience with RAN components, gNodeB / base station software, or integration with network elements (nice to have). Experience building HALs, software abstractions, and stable APIs for hardware integration (nice to have). Familiarity with SDKs, modem stacks, drivers and debugging tools; experience with multi-threading, synchronization and performance tuning. Excellent problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills; experience mentoring junior engineers. Result-oriented approach , with a proven ability to deliver fast and make a significant impact on business growth, demonstrate initiative, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
